svg.title: Assign Windows 365 Enterprise licenses: direct and group
svg.desc: Windows 365 Enterprise. Requirement 1: the user has a Windows 365 license, by direct assignment or by group-based licensing. Requirement 2: the user is in the group that a provisioning policy is assigned to. With both in place the Cloud PC shows Provisioned. If the license or the policy link is removed, the Cloud PC keeps working for seven days in a grace period, then it is deprovisioned.
svg.text: Requirement 1: the user has a Windows 365 license
Required to use a Cloud PC
Requirement 2: the user is in the policy group
